interface.signature: def validateBinaryTreeNodes(n: int, leftChild: List[int], rightChild: List[int]) -> bool

preconditions.expression: isinstance(n, int) and n >= 1 and n <= 10**4
preconditions.description: n is an integer between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.
leftChild is a list of length n.
rightChild is a list of length n.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and -1 <= x < n for x in leftChild)
preconditions.description: Each element in leftChild is an integer between -1 and n-1 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and -1 <= x < n for x in rightChild)
preconditions.description: Each element in rightChild is an integer between -1 and n-1 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == (len(set(x for x in range(n) if x not in leftChild + rightChild)) == 1 and all(x == -1 or x not in (leftChild[x], rightChild[x]) for x in range(n)) and all(len([y for y in range(n) if x in (leftChild[y], rightChild[y])]) <= 1 for x in range(n)) and not any(cycle_exists(n, leftChild, rightChild, x) for x in range(n)))
postconditions.description: The function returns True if and only if there is exactly one root, no node has more than one parent, and there are no cycles in the tree.
